dialogues.speaker: Hao
dialogues.text: Are you looking for work around here? If you are, I'd advise that you leave. There's nothing left to mine.

dialogues.speaker: Hao
dialogues.text: Me? Well, I don't have any other talents other than mining, and you've got to make Mora somehow, am I right? Heh. Don't worry, I reckon I can still make ends meet this way.

dialogues.speaker: Hao
dialogues.text: Still, people like us miners... We aren't an awfully talented lot. We tend to stick to this one path, unlike you adventurers. Going out and seeing the world as you like... If only I could do that.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, there are other people around.

dialogues.speaker: Hao
dialogues.text: Oh, you mean Tu? He's just like me. Not a talent in the world apart from mining, and not a lot of connections, either. *sigh* I wish I could be like him, you know? Being lost in his own happy little world like that.
